chunks: Do not supplicate for help today; you will not be rescued by Us;

key_terms.تَجْأَرُوا: Supplicate for help or cry outcall for assistance

ai.seo_question: What does the command 'La taj'aru' signify in the context of the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine decree, illustrating how the disbelievers' own rejection severs their connection to the source of salvation. It serves as a poignant reminder that divine aid is contingent upon faith and adherence to the truth, rather than mere existence or status.
